name: Green Business Scheme - Haryana
benefit: 1. The Corporation, in collaboration with NSFDC, provides a loan for various economic development schemes having a unit cost up to ₹2,00,000/-. 1. The Corporation provides margin money @10% of the project cost. 1. The Corporation (HSFDC) provides a subsidy of 50% of the total project cost, with a maximum amount of subsidy being ₹10,000/- of the total project cost.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Haryana. 1. The applicant should be in the age group of 18 to 45 years. 1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Caste category. 1. The applicant's annual family income should be up to ₹3,00,000/-. **Note:** The income ceiling is at least 50% of the beneficiaries having an annual family income up to ₹1,50,000/-, and the balance 50% of the beneficiaries having an annual family income up to ₹3,00,000/-.
